spacecraft_docking_undocking_date.description: The "spacecraft docking/undocking date" of this Spacecraft, as defined by the Space Ontology.
spacecraft_docking_undocking_date.instructions: Only fill this field when the source text explicitly states it; otherwise leave it empty. Each value must use the exact surface form as it appears in the source text, without normalizing its words. When the text states several values, for instance as an enumeration, extract each value on its own and separate them with ";": "written for violin, cello and piano" gives "violin; cello; piano". Dates must be written in the format "<DD> <Month> <YYYY>". When the source text states only a year, use "01 January <YYYY>".
